_comment: Copy this next to a job posting, rewrite the bullets to mirror it, then: node build.js --id <application-id> --bullets <this file>. Keys are job ids from $CV_SOURCE_DIR/resume.data.json. A job you leave out keeps its baseline bullets. Keep the counts close to the baseline so the CV stays two pages.
nasctech: Bullet 1 for the most recent role - carries the target job's primary stack.
chi-software: Bullet 1 for the previous role - depth, domain, scale, secondary keywords.

_skills.Databases:: only when the owner authorised a one-off change; see amendments.md
